Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Anoop Srivastava, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Anant Pratap Singh, the learned Additional Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No.585 of 2022, under Section 420 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Gangaghat,
District Unnao.
3.

The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 21.11.2022 against 8 persons, including the applicant, stating that accused persons have illegally carved out plots and thereby caused damages to the public property.
4.
In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail-application, it has been contended that the applicant is innocent, and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

In para 18 of the affidavit, applicant's involvement in 3 other cases has been disclosed; in one case, the investigating officer has filed final report; in 2nd case, the applicant has been granted bail; and 3rd case relates to offences under U.P. Gangsters and Anti Social Activities (Prevention) Act.

5. After investigation charge-sheet has already been submitted on 15.07.2023.
Regarding the applicant only this much is stated that he has introduced the purchaser to the seller.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that only allegation against the applicant is that he had introduced the purchaser to the seller; that investigation of the case already stands concluded and the applicant was not arrested during investigation, and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
